column1: # EXP-R2-228: does in-context homologue conditioning exist at all in a frozen decoder?
# The GPU half of D1.i, and the only half that needs a card. Everything that
# decides WHAT is measured -- the DIAMOND all-against-all band structure, the BM25
# passage bands, the local-overlap screen, the per-arm token budget and the
# realised k -- is a CPU fact and was published on the workstation before any
# checkpoint was loaded, which is the registration's own operational sequence.
# What runs here is forward passes and nothing else: no sampling, no gradient.
# TWO CARDS, NOT THREE. A concurrent official campaign holds cuda:2 of this
# allocation, so every cell here is scheduled on cuda:0 or cuda:1 and two cells
# share a slot. A cell whose card is not idle is REFUSED and not launched, which
# is the property that keeps this campaign from displacing that one.
# STAGING BEFORE DISPATCH. The frozen cohort and the four per-arm plans are
# evidence rather than code, so they do not travel inside the snapshot. Push them
# to <results_run_dir>/cohort.json and <results_run_dir>/plan_<arm>.json before
# launching -- the shape EXP-R2-226 used for wildtypes.json and EXP-R2-227 for
# class_queue.json -- and they are nobody's expect basename, because an input
# staged beside a result is not completion. Every cell verifies the cohort's
# content digest and the plan's, and a plan pinned to another cohort is refused:
# the plan's item indices would name records that cohort does not hold.
# SLOTS 1-2 ARE THE INTERFACE GATE. Each self-check resolves the arm's declared
# rendering, locates the scored span against the marker prefix -- a BPE merge
# straddling that boundary would move the span this campaign's whole contrast
# lives on -- and records a fixed record's NLL at the campaign precision.
# SLOTS 3-12 ARE THE FROZEN CONDITION ORDER, and it is the registration's: the
# position-only and mono-shuffled controls are the two conditions most likely to
# close the line, so they are measured before the condition the campaign hopes
# for. no_context follows them; it is a diagnostic that exists only to price the
# position-only control against the registration's own failure branch, it is
# never the effect, and the analysis refuses to gate on it.
# float32 ON EVERY ARM AND EVERY CONDITION. The endpoint is a paired difference
# between two log-likelihoods a few hundredths of a nat apart, every arm here is
# under 800M parameters, and a reduced-precision cast buys nothing a 143 GB card
# needs. Declared, identical across arms and conditions, and recorded in every
# artefact.
# The analysis is NOT here. --stage analyse loads no model; it runs on the
# workstation over the pulled artefacts, which is also where the group bootstrap's
# 2,000 resamples on seed 20260826 are frozen.
